message.content:
**Signers of the United States Declaration of Independence (July 4, 1776)**  

| State | Signers (in order of appearance on the original parchment) |
|-------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, George Calvert |
| **Pennsylvania** | Robert Morris, Benjamin Rush, Benjamin Franklin, John Morton, George Clymer, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Ross, John Penn, George Whitefield |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Witherspoon, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Abraham Clark, William Livingston, John Hart, William Livingston |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, John Adams, Robert Treat Paine, Elbridge Gerry, Paul Revere, John Hancock (again), John Hancock (again) |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll of Carrollton |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., Joseph Hewes, William Hooper |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, James Monroe, Thomas Jefferson, Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton |
| **New Hampshire** | John Langdon, Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Matthew Thornton |
| **Vermont** | (Vermont was not yet a state; no signers from Vermont) |

> **Total:** 56 signers.

These men signed the Declaration on **August 2, 1776** at the Pennsylvania State House (now Independence Hall) in Philadelphia. The document was adopted by the Continental Congress on **July 4, 1776**, but the actual signatures were added later.
